# Appeal of Denial — Lower Back Disc Surgery / Decompression (CPT 63030)

**Governing Policy:** Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114) — https://www.ambetterhealth.com/content/dam/centene/ambetteril/clinical-policies/CP.MP.114.pdf

**Member:** Jordan Foster
**Member ID:** W794852405
**Plan:** Ambetter (WellCare), Commercial/ACA, North Carolina
**Denial date:** 2026-08-07
**Reference number:** POC-EE22487639-86426
**Appeal deadline:** Must be received by 2027-02-03 (180 days from the denial notice date; the address on my denial letter is the correct address to use)

---

Dear Ambetter (WellCare) Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for CPT 63030 (lower back disc surgery/decompression). My surgeon, Dr. Reyes, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary. The denial states that "the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery." I am asking the plan to reconsider this decision because my medical records show that I have met the plan's own published criteria under CP.MP.114.

## The Plan's Criteria and How My Records Meet Them

The policy states that discectomy is medically necessary when meeting all of the following:

> "discectomy are medically necessary when meeting all of the following:"

### 1. Diagnosis of herniated lumbar disc

The policy requires:

> "Dia gnosis of herniated lumbar disc;"

My MRI of the lumbar spine, dated 2026-06-28, documents an L4-L5 disc extrusion.

### 2. Nerve root compression confirmed by imaging

The policy requires:

> "Ne rve root compression confirmed by imaging and one of the following:"

The same MRI documents "severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root."

### 3. Radiculopathy with sensory deficit

The policy states this pathway is met by:

> "Radiculopathy with sensory deficit as evidenced by pain, parasthesias or numbness in a nerve root distribution, and member/enrollee has failed to respond to conservative ther apy including all the following:"

My records document radicular pain radiating into my right calf, consistent with a nerve root distribution, along with positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level.

### 4. Failed conservative therapy within the last year

The policy requires all of the following:

> "a) ≥ four wee ks physical therapy or prescribed home exercise program, or documentation of member/enrollee's inability to tolerate;"

I completed 16 supervised physical therapy visits over 10 weeks (2026-05-03 to 2026-07-12), well beyond the four-week minimum, as documented in my physical therapy discharge note.

> "b) ≥ four weeks activity modification;"

[Please confirm documentation of ≥4 weeks of activity modification — for example, from physical therapy notes or clinic notes — and add the specific dates/details here.]

> "1) Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) or acetaminophen ≥ thre e weeks unless contraindicated or not tolerated;"

I used NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate relief, well beyond the three-week minimum.

> "2) Epidural steroid inj ection;"

I received a corticosteroid injection on 2026-06-09, which gave 3 weeks of partial relief. [If this injection was administered as an epidural steroid injection, please confirm this in the procedure note so the record clearly matches this criterion.]

## Summary

Based on the records described above, my diagnosis, imaging findings, and conservative care to date correspond to the plan's own published criteria for medical necessity of discectomy under CP.MP.114. My symptoms have also continued for 12 months, with functional limitations including the inability to stand more than 10 minutes.

## What I Am Asking For

I am respectfully asking the plan to reconsider its denial of CPT 63030 and to approve this surgery based on the records already submitted and any additional documentation provided in this appeal. If any additional records are needed from Dr. Reyes's office to confirm the activity-modification or injection details noted above, please let us know what is needed and I will have my provider's office submit it promptly.

Thank you for reconsidering my case.

Sincerely,

[Jordan Foster]
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
Member ID: W794852405
Date: [date of submission]

---

**How to submit this appeal:**
Online: ambetterhealth.com (select your state, then the appeal/grievance form)
By phone: the number on your Ambetter ID card
By mail: the appeal address printed on your denial notice
Deadline: must be received by 2027-02-03
